prediction.model: LightGBM on physics features + Sightglass rationale engine
prediction.rationale:
Cooler: full efficiency. Evidence: TS4 mean temperature 30.9 °C (within 1% of healthy); TS2 mean temperature 41.5 °C (within 1% of healthy). Heat exchanger maintains expected fluid cooling delta without thermal drift.
Valve: close to total failure. Evidence: PS1/PS2 valve switching lag 9.99 s (within 2% of healthy); PS2 pressure rise time 9.69 s (4% above healthy). Transient response is severely sluggish, preventing timely transition of working pressure.
Pump leakage: severe leakage. Evidence: FS1 mean volume flow 6.36 l/min (3% below healthy); EPS1/FS1 power-to-flow ratio 403 W·min/l (5% above healthy); SE system efficiency factor 54.8 % (6% below healthy). High power-to-flow ratio demonstrates extensive internal leakage across the pump chambers.
Accumulator: close to total failure. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 47.6 bar (within 2% of healthy). Pressure buffering is largely ineffective due to compromised pre-charge pressure in the accumulator.
